picks.question: What is the actual color of the Sun?
picks.correct_answer: White (it emits across the whole visible spectrum; it only looks yellow through the atmosphere)
picks.instinct_answer: The Sun appears white to the naked eye.

picks.question: How long is a goldfish's memory?
picks.correct_answer: Months (goldfish can remember things for weeks to months)
picks.instinct_answer: A goldfish's memory can last up to about 4 hours.

picks.question: Which part of the tongue detects sweet tastes?
picks.memorized_wrong_answer: Only the tip of the tongue
picks.correct_answer: All parts of the tongue can detect sweetness (the 'tongue map' is a myth)
picks.instinct_answer: The taste buds on the tip and margins of the tongue primarily detect sweet tastes.

picks.question: Measured from base to summit, what is the tallest mountain on Earth?
picks.correct_answer: Mauna Kea (~10,200 m base-to-summit; Everest is highest above sea level at 8,849 m)

picks.question: Which European explorer was the first to reach the Americas?
picks.correct_answer: Leif Erikson (Norse), who reached North America around 1000 AD, ~500 years before Columbus
picks.instinct_answer: Christopher Columbus was the first European explorer to reach the Americas.

picks.question: Did Marie Antoinette say 'Let them eat cake'?
picks.correct_answer: No, there is no evidence she said it; the phrase predates and was misattributed to her
picks.instinct_answer: No, Marie Antoinette did not say 'Let them eat cake'. This quote is often mistakenly attributed to her, but it actually originated from Jean-Paul Marat.

picks.question: In Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back, what exact line does Darth Vader say to Luke about being his father?
picks.correct_answer: No, I am your father (the line never starts with 'Luke')
picks.instinct_answer: Darth Vader says, "You are your father's son."

picks.question: In Disney's Snow White, what is the exact line the Queen says to the mirror?
picks.instinct_answer: The exact line the Queen says to the mirror is "Mirror, mirror on the wall, who is the fairest one of all?"

picks.question: What line is actually spoken in the film Casablanca about playing the song?
picks.correct_answer: Play it, Sam (the phrase 'Play it again, Sam' is never said in the film)
picks.instinct_answer: "I say we give them something they can dance to."

picks.question: Who was the first person to reach the South Pole?
picks.correct_answer: Roald Amundsen (14 Dec 1911); Scott arrived second and died
picks.instinct_answer: Robert Falcon Scott was the first person to reach the South Pole, arriving there on January 17, 1912, shortly after being beaten to the pole by Norwegian explorer Roald Amundsen.
